name: Hamish Hunter
intro: I am a Data infrastructure engineer. I manage the complex balance of keeping a Supercomputer (HPC) operational while architecting the broader Linux infrastructure that keeps the business running. My role is as much about strategy and roadmapping as it is about execution. I oversee everything from large-scale monitoring and incident response to ensuring the deep security of our systems. I’m heavily involved in the VMware/Aria and Broadcom ecosystem, using SaltStack to drive the automation that makes our scale manageable. I enjoy sharing my knowledge and helping others get comfortable with complex tools when I’m the subject matter expert on a project. I thrive under the pressure of diverse responsibilities and am always looking to master new architectures to keep our systems resilient and moving forward.
